title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Current Canadian jobs-portal results validated from full job descriptions. Scores measure technical fit only.
latest_update: Updated September 21, 2026 - one exceptional remote match remains live and is already in the pipeline.

rows.title: Senior Salesforce DevOps Engineer - AI Automation
rows.gap: Four to eight years of AI experience is stated as required, although the practical AI-governance, Salesforce, Azure, CI/CD and cross-team influence scope is unusually close.

notes_sections.heading: Validation notes
items: The Flextrack posting remains accessible and explicitly open to Canada-based candidates. It is permanent, remote, and was posted July 31, 2026.
Platform searches also surfaced QA, embedded software, data/AI and infrastructure-support noise; those roles were outside the target families.

method: All six default title queries were run through Procom's live jobs portal. Visible cards were deduplicated and plausible target roles were opened and validated.
